reason: A vision bridge that converts image attachments into text descriptions through a configured vision model so text-only DeepSeek sessions can process image-based input.

summaries.zh: 将用户图片附件交给配置的视觉模型生成文字描述，并回填到纯文本 DeepSeek 会话中。
summaries.en: Converts user image attachments into text descriptions through a configured vision model for use in text-only DeepSeek sessions.

capabilities: Sends image attachments to a configured vision model for textual description
Replaces image content with generated text before forwarding requests to text-only models
Caches descriptions by session and attachment when enabled
Continues with placeholder text when vision processing fails
